trap_summary_zh: 跨模型检测须先识别退化或常数分数等数据/模型病态；若将 Model C 等同良性得分等异常当作「稳定」并推荐部署高 AUC，属将异常当发现（T09）。

content: cross_model_detection_report.md flags degenerate or constant score patterns before interpreting AUC; Model C benign identical scores are treated as data pathology, not model stability.
keywords: Report notes identical benign entropy scores for model_C (or equivalent anomaly).
High AUC on model_C is not recommended as deployment evidence without re-collection or fix.
Recommendations distinguish trustworthy metrics from artifact-driven separation.
